summary_1line: Draupadi explains to Satyabhama the duties and discipline by which a wife wins her husband’s devotion, stressing service, loyalty, restraint, and household responsibility.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi and Satyabhama sit together in a forest hermitage as Draupadi calmly instructs her friend on the duties of a devoted wife.
Draupadi rises at dawn in the royal palace, overseeing servants and the vast treasury while the Pandava court awakens around her.
Satyabhama embraces Draupadi before departing with Krishna, offering comforting words about the future defeat of the Kauravas.
